newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mitsubishi unit sets 3.0 bln peso expansion.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi unit sets 3.0 bln peso expansion.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines is earmarking 3.0 billion pesos to be invested over the next eight years to expand its current production capacity in the country, company officials said on Sunday.
Company president Makoto Maeda said the capital outlay would improve its annual production to 120,000 units by year 2004 from 47,500 units this year.
He said part of the amount would be used in building new assembly plant in a 50-hectare lot in Cainta, east of Manila.
Maeda said the move will raise its market share to 28 percent from the present 25 percent.
Mitsubishi Motors Philippines is a joint venture between Mitsubishi Motors Corp and Nissho Iwai Corp.
